title: French 101 Comprehensive Final

domains.focus: être/avoir, agreement, dates/time, questions/negation, present-tense routines
café, objects/locations, directions, transport, conversation repair
new short connected beginner texts with gist, details, inference and source limits
new spoken beginner messages; no visible transcript before response
novel situations, error analysis, cross-unit reasoning

objective_section.form_strategy: parallel equivalent forms, not identical memorized retries

writing.requirement: 12–16 connected beginner sentences responding to an unfamiliar practical or descriptive prompt

speaking.requirement: short unfamiliar interpersonal or presentational task without reading a complete prepared script

listening.independence_rule: spoken source must be unfamiliar and presented before any transcript
listening.fallback_rule: written transcript fallback changes measurement scope and cannot be recorded as independent listening mastery

reviewer_policy: Reviewer role records context and evidence; Parent and Teacher may be the same person. Independent third-party attestation is required only when a specific final-performance prompt explicitly requires it.

completion_policy.performance_requirement: writing and speaking evidence reviewed; listening measurement mode recorded
completion_policy.certificate_transition: future canonical certificate path must be versioned separately and must not invalidate preserved 12-level certificates

release_gates: minimum 120-item vetted objective bank with stable IDs
closed-book UI behavior and no premature answer disclosure
